description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceHandler class in an Android project. The tests check various methods related to device information, status, permissions, and health, ensuring they return expected data structures and values.

classes.name: DeviceHandlerTest
classes.description: Test suite for the DeviceHandler class, verifying its methods handle device info, status, permissions, and health correctly.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo_returnsStablePayload
methods.description: Tests that handleDeviceInfo method returns a payload with expected device information fields.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Verifies that handleDeviceStatus method returns a payload with correct nested metrics on device status.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Checks that handleDevicePermissions method yields a permissions payload with expected permission statuses and capabilities.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsSendOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Tests logic that treats partial SMS permission grants as sufficient for capability.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsReadOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Tests logic that treats read-only partial SMS permission grants as sufficient for capability.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsNoSmsGrantAsDenied
methods.description: Ensures no SMS grant results in denial capability.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsDisabledSmsAsDenied
methods.description: Checks that SMS disabled flag results in denial capability.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsMissingTelephonyAsDenied
methods.description: Verifies that missing telephony results in denial.

methods.name: isSmsPromptable
methods.description: Determines whether SMS permission prompts should be shown based on current grant status.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_marksCallLogUnpromptableWhenFeatureDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that call log permission is marked unpromptable if feature is disabled.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Checks that handleDeviceHealth returns a payload with expected device health metrics.
